Testing Validators & Middleware

The Week 3 habit: a unit test suite that grows alongside services/validators, not bolted on at the end.

  • Testing a Validator Directly

    No app, no mocked Prisma client — a Zod schema is a plain function call, so testing it is just that.

  • Testing Middleware Without an App

    validate.js is just a function that reads req and calls next() or res — a fake req/res object is enough.

  • Growing the Integration Suite

    Comment and Tag get their own supertest files; Ticket's grows to cover every new route this lesson added.
